title: Sentences and Their Kinds
theory:
 A sentence is a group of words that expresses a complete thought.

       Kinds of Sentence
       1 Assertive Sentence – Expresses a statement, fact, or opinion.
      		Ex. I am studying English.
        Interrogative Sentence – Asks a question.

      		Ex. Do you play chess?
      				 Where are you going?
        Imperative Sentence – Expresses a command, request, order or advice etc.

      		Ex. Close the door.
      				 Bring a glass of water.
        Optative Sentence – Expresses a wish, prayer, blessings, or curse.

      		Ex. God bless you.
      				 May you succeed in life.
        Exclamatory Sentence – Expresses sudden feelings like joy, sorrow, surprise, or

        anger.
      		Ex. What a beautiful house.
      				 Hurray! I have got selected in SSC.

        Note
      What + a/an + Adjective + Noun
      How + Adjective/Adverb + Subject + Verb
